name: Layer3 USD live spot collateral valuation
summary: Loan.supply valued deposited BTCB with PancakeSwap Router V2's current two-token quote and minted LUSD from that quote. The successful receipt temporarily displaced the referenced BTCB/USDT reserves, so the LUSD minted against 0.001515366635982742 BTCB exceeded the independently valued collateral retained by the Loan contract.

loss.notes: The LUSD pool's archive USDT balance falls by 9,800.402958646947704433 in the incident block. The receipt decomposes that change exactly: 100.004111822928037800 USDT is paired with endogenous L3 and capitalized into 16.110436463978777246 Cake-LP minted to and retained by the pool, while 9,700.398846824019666633 USDT leaves the victim entity for the attacker helper. The Loan contract simultaneously retains the attacker's exact 0.001515366635982742-BTCB deposit. Immediately before the loss, Pancake pair 0x3f803ec2b816ea7f06ec76aa2b6f2532f9892d62 held 39,642.343651114056995536 USDT and 1.308898664806062396 BTCB, with reserve timestamp 1688739223. The reserve-implied price is the exact ratio 39,642.343651114056995536 / 1.308898664806062396, approximately $30,286.793559368329840326123063709099959686246757061248349441343945552583311207193 per BTCB; DefiLlama independently corroborates it with a preceding $30,277 observation at 1688739768. The exact collateral-credit rational is (0.001515366635982742 × 39,642.343651114056995536) / 1.308898664806062396 dollars, approximately $45.895596470763762791825835613590524256663991716609547910720118830076326619601439. Subtracting that rational from the external USDT outflow gives net loss approximately $9,654.5032503532559038411741643864094757433360082833904520892798811699236733803986. No BTCB was returned to the attacker: the collateral stayed in Loan until protocol manager transaction 0xe5dfbf3d1f27f00efee13b465d877ac7d5bef7c978016659aeb9b3ac8e9c0050 later swept the aggregate 0.001533265791594517-BTCB balance to 0x81f319f3cba6abb3ba555b6e6cf4debb1fd93568. That later protocol disposition does not change the incident-time credit. Five nested flash lenders received their USDT principal back; the six preceding calls reverted; and the next successful EOA transaction forwarded the already measured 9,464.716730420359231245-USDT proceeds without returning assets to the victim.

ageReset.description: setInfo configured BTCB to pay LUSD, with redeemFee 500, supplyRatio 5000 and dailyRate 3 in the four consecutive mapping slots. This was the first and only pre-incident BTCB configuration and made the live BTCB/USDT quote path operational; later setInfo calls addressed other tokens.

sources.note: Reviewed the complete incident receipt and call trace; archive balances for the LUSD pool, Loan, BTCB/USDT pair and retained LP claim; all ten EOA campaign transactions from the two helper creations through the six reverted calls, sole loss and proceeds forwarding; every direct Loan call from deployment through the loss; the verified Loan source and storage layout; runtime history; and the later BTCB disposition. The six reverted calls are 0xdc674a306a54e68466fd97b8636306e6d68df87166c441d6e282ca3ecb54ca20, 0x33236294904398daaee20faaf2b9fabbf16c502dc57f09e44bd1c0c6347e424b, 0x3b2158484ec411c340ebc46343b3f8d69f2fe9f5fffd3dee1e694d657e398e03, 0x8c1b62494294539aa2824845a7671d7de8d9aef11628d2a2dcd59427771f32a1, 0x0e302c3df68e650336b38672ed43272784c96cc9e3b883ae3c7828c104d39881 and 0xdc96a34b8ee6b16902a808d3658b68d0799d7dac8a89f99c513f68a6bff6c53d. They are recorded as scope evidence here rather than successful structured sources. The source-1 trace calls direct Loan 0xdec12a1dcbc1f741ccd02dfd862ab226f6383003 supply(address,uint256), whose verified runtime asks immutable Pancake Router V2 for the current BTCB-to-USDT amount and mints LUSD from that quote before retaining BTCB. Source-6 first configured the BTCB mapping at block 29033499:21. It wrote LUSD 0x3cd632c25a4db4c1a636cfb23b9285be1097a60d to mapping base slot 0x020d60ee64c79b1375e5b7d880a4827df313abb64d06701957dd261da203f45e and 500, 5000 and 3 to the next three slots. All fourteen direct pre-incident transactions were enumerated; later setInfo calls changed only other collateral-token entries. The direct runtime is absent one block before source-4, is 8,392 bytes at creation, and hashes to 0x3b30c3ef56e422e8175732fdfb75b4617d82eeaa6e8dfaecef050d4ff9ac9d5c at creation, activation and immediately before source-1. The operational BTCB configuration was 2,176,636 seconds old at the sole successful loss receipt.
